body:
Before I mention anything I should warn that I've been taking Effexor XR 225mg for several years and I'm 6'2 tall so the results for this experience may make it different than for others trying methocarbomal.
Anywho, I was dropped off by my brother in the pharmacy (a place which has become a favorite of mine for obvious reasons lol) I had been reading around that robaxin wasn't much for a recreational drug but I wanted to test that. As soon as they gave me my bottle, I left and popped 3 (2250mg) and it took about an hour before I started feeling anything.
My eyelids lowered like the first time I smoke weed and my legs began to feel smooth and 'unrestricted'. Everything from the trip back to the car and to my house I felt a little 'good' and a bit too relaxed but in a good way. The Jeep was sooo comfortable and I couldn't help but smile at the strangers outside of the car. When I got home I sneaked 3000mg into my mouth (4 nasty tasting pills) and in about 30-45 minutes I was feeling like Johnny Depp in Fear & Loathing in that scene where his legs turn to rubber from the ether. I was stumbling with 5250mg and my speech was sort of slurred. The two dosages hit me in less than 2 hours and they were good.
Oh and lastly, they gave me the coonfidance push I needed to call my ex and ask to see her for some ex sex lol.
